items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Skeets had this little arrangement by Archie Bleyer. ... I was on drums. Russell Procope was on alto saxophone. John Kirby was on bass.

ctx.x: And that was after Jelly Roll.

Yeah, that was after Jelly Roll. Then I did another little thing, up around the same Band Box and Rhythm Club, it was a great arranger around there and he used to do a lot of dancing school gigs. Name was Charlie Skeets.
